meta.name: Cloud Orbit Command
meta.description: An immersive 3D-first DevOps portfolio where an interactive cloud core, orbital infrastructure nodes, and scroll-driven scene changes lead into legible engineering evidence.

primary.role: deployment paths, active states, section indices, and system controls

secondary.role: inspection signals, focus rings, topology nodes, and live status

accent.role: focal WebGL energy, primary calls to action, and selected highlights

neutral.usage: White and #f4f7fb are primary foregrounds in dark mode; #07090d and #0d1118 form the canvas and panels. Light mode reverses this relationship without changing hierarchy.

color.contrast_strategy: Near-white editorial text on deep neutral fields with cyan, blue, and violet reserved for signals; all body text targets WCAG AA.

typography.font_style_notes: One Vietnamese-capable Roboto family across all roles; technical character comes from tabular numerals, uppercase metadata, spacing, and rules rather than a second display face.

spacing.section_rhythm: Large cinematic pauses between sections, compact metadata clusters, and consistent 1rem or 1.5rem internal steps.

layout.grid_system: Twelve-column fluid editorial grid with system-diagram overlays
layout.alignment_tendency: Asymmetric editorial on desktop, single-column narrative on mobile

shape.border_usage: Precise one-pixel signal rules and angular clipped corners; pills are restricted to compact status indicators.
shape.divider_style: Low-contrast hairline with occasional cyan-to-violet gradient segment

elevation.shadow_style: Ambient glow plus constructed tonal layers
elevation.depth_cues: Overlapping wireframes, glow intensity, controlled blur, perspective transforms, and WebGL particle depth

iconography.preferred_set: Existing custom inline SVG system icons

motion.entrance_pattern: Premium fade with 0.985-to-1 scale and a short upward settle
motion.exit_pattern: Accelerated fade with minimal downward displacement
motion.philosophy: Premium technical choreography: primary content first, system evidence second, ambient field last; no overshoot and no decorative motion that competes with reading.

components.button_style: Angular 48px controls with one-pixel rules, active light sweep, and compact directional icon
components.input_style: Dark ruled field with visible cyan focus ring and no floating label
components.card_style: Editorial signal panel with clipped corner, faint grid, and border highlight rather than conventional shadow
components.navigation_pattern: Sticky translucent command bar with visible primary routes, language state, theme, search, and GitHub
components.modal_style: Centered elevated command panel with dim backdrop, crisp border, and short premium transition
components.list_style: Numbered evidence rows on shared baselines with compact status and technology metadata
components.component_notes: Cards remain content-first; Three.js is a contextual layer, not an interaction requirement.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: An observatory for infrastructure signals and delivery paths
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary computational editorial with restrained retro-terminal cues

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous section whitespace with compact evidence groupings
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Large typographic claims balanced by low-opacity spatial fields
visual_language.focal_strategy: One dominant interactive WebGL hero object followed by progressive project evidence
visual_language.texture_usage: Fine noise, sparse dot matrices, and subtle scan-grid registration

composition.hierarchy_method: Scale contrast, spatial isolation, and signal color
composition.flow_direction: Top-to-bottom narrative with diagonal and orbital counter-motion
composition.grouping_strategy: Editorial sections, evidence rails, and bounded system diagrams
composition.negative_space_role: Creates calm around dense technical evidence and lets ambient 3D remain peripheral

imagery.photo_treatment: No decorative photography; company marks remain clean and high contrast
imagery.illustration_style: Generative topology, orbital nodes, wireframe geometry, and diagrammatic SVG
imagery.graphic_elements: Signal arcs, point fields, registration crosses, node paths, and clipped planes
imagery.pattern_usage: Sparse grid and dot field used at low opacity
imagery.image_shape: Wide landscape system canvases with small angular corners

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate and precise with light, border, and 1-2px transform responses
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Signal edge brightens while content lifts no more than 4px
interaction_feel.loading_style: Small orbital signal with percentage or status text

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Direct, technically credible, and grounded in evidence
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Explain the next useful action in one concise sentence

overview.fallback_strategy: Disable WebGL on reduced motion or low-end devices and retain a static CSS grid, radial signal glows, and all content.

background_effects.description: A full-viewport black spatial field led by a luminous cloud core, concentric deployment rings, orbital infrastructure nodes, and deep particle dust.

particle_systems.description: A deep dust field surrounds the hero core while brighter deploy particles and orbital nodes define the active infrastructure path.

params.movement_pattern: slow orbital drift with depth parallax
params.color_behavior: cyan through violet based on normalized position
params.interaction: pointer parallax, raycast node focus, and drag-to-orbit on desktop
params.spawn_area: spherical shell around the hero core with foreground and background depth

3d_elements.description: A large shader-displaced cloud core with particle skin, luminous energy rings, orbiting AWS/Kubernetes/GitOps nodes, and floating data fragments.

params.renderer: WebGLRenderer with ACES tone mapping, antialiasing, DPR capped at 1.6, and EffectComposer
params.lighting: Shader-driven Fresnel rim, emissive nodes, additive particles, and a restrained hemisphere/key-light pair
params.camera: Perspective camera, 38 degree FOV, cinematic z movement driven by hero scroll progress
params.materials: Custom Fresnel/displacement ShaderMaterial, additive point sprites, emissive MeshStandardMaterial, and ruled wireframe
params.geometry: High-detail icosahedral core, torus and curve-based rings, surface point skin, orbit nodes, and deep particle shell
params.interaction_model: Pointer parallax, drag-to-orbit, raycast node response, scroll-driven camera move; static fallback on touch/reduced-motion

shader_effects.description: The core surface displaces and breathes while Fresnel rim light, scan bands, and point sprites shift through cyan, blue, and violet.

params.vertex_manipulation: Layered sine and value-noise displacement along normals plus perspective-scaled point size
params.fragment_output: Dark volumetric core with luminous Fresnel rim and scan bands; feathered additive sprites for its particle skin
params.distortion: 6-10% organic core displacement with low-frequency breathing

parallax.speed_curve: GSAP scrub 0.6 with counter-motion between copy, HUD, and WebGL stage

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: hero pinned from top to +=55vh; content enters at top 86%
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: pinned 3D scene transition, by-word hero reveal, project perspective settle, SVG path draw
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: scrubbed hero and project depth; triggered once for supporting content

scroll_morphing.description: Desktop hero pins briefly while the cloud core scales, rotates, and recedes as the copy resolves into the technology rail.

text_effects.description: The hero claim arrives by word with depth and a masked vertical reveal; selected signals retain the cyan-blue-violet highlight.

cursor_effects.description: Fine-pointer primary actions move at most 4px toward the cursor; the WebGL camera counter-moves.

params.interaction_zone: primary actions and WebGL canvas only

image_effects.description: System diagram canvases tilt by no more than two degrees and brighten their active route on hover.

canvas_drawings.description: Three.js owns the generative field; a second Canvas 2D loop is unnecessary.

svg_animations.description: Existing architecture routes draw once as each system diagram enters the viewport.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The first viewport is intentionally 3D-first: ThreeUI Rings supplies the typographic/orbital scale, Orbital Sphere informs the particle core, and Orrery informs luminous rotating paths. The scene remains behind semantic HTML rather than replacing it. GSAP pins and resolves the hero on desktop, then project cards use restrained perspective depth. Mobile removes pinning and bloom resolution; reduced-motion receives a static radial core, complete text, and no continuous spatial movement.
